# Run Vault on AWS

You can deploy Vault on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with
[HCP Vault Dedicated](/hcp/docs/vault/what-is-hcp-vault).

<Note>

HashiCorp no longer releases Vault as Amazon Machine Images (AMIs).

</Note>
